It's basically just a place for psychopaths who have been playing the game for 20 years and who have multiple accounts to gank you.

I'm not kidding. The game is designed with two modes of play.

1. Play the game, do missions, mine etc.

2. Fly around and kill those people who are trying to play the game.

The majority of players are in category 2.

The game is built so that if your ship is specced to mine or run missions, you are automatically not fitted out for PVP.

This means that anybody who wants to gank you will have a supreme advantage in the fight. They are fitting for PVP, you are fitted for PVE, thus you die.

The game has this stupid 1 win button called the warp scrambler which makes it so you cannot escape with your ship. They just show up, push their scram button and you eventually die. The scram doesn't take much capacitor, it doesn't wear off, it has no negatives at all.

There are modules that can help mitigate the warp scrambler but those modules all suck and none of them are things you would be using if you were PVE specced.

Its a game of wolves and sheep. And the vast majority of the sheep have quit. Now when you see eve online's player count, most of those are 2nd or 3rd accounts.

Don't waste your time or money. Give this a miss.

Well, it's a hardcore PvP game with permaloss... Everyone has to decide for himself, whether he can live with it or not. Fact is though, that by flying smart, you can avoid PvP to such a degree, that losses through ganks will simply be negligible. So it's not wolves and sheep, but rather wolves VS a rapidly reproducing sheep flock, guarded by a shepherd and very vicious dogs (as long as the sheeps don't stray too far). And the fun part is, that sheep can become wolves themselves overnight and wolves can become sheep.
Now let's add the fact, that it's an MMO and things become even more complex, because suddenly sheep have wolves to guard them and supply the wolves with high end claws and teeth, so they can rip other wolves to pieces harder, or turn on the sheep...

Its not really a hard core pvp game. It's a gank fest. You either fit for PVE and get murdered or you fit for PVP and murder unsuspecting randos just trying to mine.

A real pvp game wouldn't have mining ships or PVE fits at all. A real pvp game wouldn't gimp players and force them into unwinnable fights.

I get it that its an MMO and it has dimensions that you describe as a result. But the community is so toxic and full of such riff raff lowlife gankers that really partnering with those sorts of people is pretty much out of the question.

If an MMO wants to have the kind of social dimensions that you are talking about it should first provide a game structure that rewards that competence and cooperation rather than rewarding ganking. Eve is a study in stockholm syndrome more than it is a functional MMO community.

No, eve isn't anything at all like real life. If real life was like eve you couldn't even commute to work without being murdered. There would be no society at all just anarchy and machine gun sounds, fire and then eerie quiet.

And yeah I think I can stand on my statement that any REAL pvp game will have some kind of symmetrical balance. Examples,

War Thunder. My combat vehicle vs his combat vehicle
Mechwarrior online. My combat vehicle vs his combat vehicle
Any shooter game. My mouse reticle vs his mouse reticle.

Compare that to eve.

My mining ship, vs their PVP fitted ship.

Hmmm see the problem? Have I made it clear?

Also I addressed the point about the corp/fleeting up with people. This community is full of toxic ganking lowlifes. I want nothing to do with people like that. And even if that was a hurdle that could be overcome, it doesn't solve any of the ganking problems in the end because you still have to solo sometimes!! You can be in the biggest best corp ever, that doesn't mean people are going to always be covering you. And when they do they are gonna expect something for it which cuts into profits, reduces the point of playing etc.

My purpose here is to provide a warning to anybody who is doing some research before buying some eve omega and trying this game out. People need to understand that this game is ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ broken.

I regret every cent I spent on this busted ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ game.

"The game, doesn't force you into any fights. It's your choice, whether you go out alone into dangerous space, or not."

It's your choice if you undock or not, the game doesn't force you...

Every min I spend on this forum I get dumber with how stupid people are.

Buch of lvl 0 droping opinions

Bring your main account next time if you want to be taken seriously.

Ah yeah the Dscan lie. Heh.. That's a good one. I'm not saying that D scan didn't save you, but it sure as F hasn't ever saved me. No matter how much I spam that stupid thing (and why doesnt it just automatically refresh am I in a spaceship or what?!?!) people have always been able to sneak up.

Imagine if a pilot in a plane had to keep hitting refresh on his radar. More bad game design.

This is some good advice but really its not going to keep people from getting ganked. It will reduce it, but the same fundamental flaws in the game mechanics are still present. This game pits PVP vs PVE players in an unequal and completely broken conflict.

That is just the way it works. Fundamentally, one class of players is completely outmatched in battle against the other, not because of skill either, but simply do to fitting/gear.

The worst part isn't even losing the isk on the ship. The worst part? How long it can take to die in some scenarios while your just scrammed and trapped dying like a rat.

You can't even come back for revenge by the time you can return with a combat fitted ship they are gone. Long long gone. And then you have to spend an hour or more refitting a new ship to replace what you lost. Wash rinse repeat...

So much time wasted all for some scumbag to get their jollies. And you know what else? If you tell them off and they report you, YOU Will get a nasty gram from the GM's threatening you with a ban.

That is right kids. The game is built to frustrate you and rob you if you want to fly a PVE ship and if you give your tormentor the verbal equivalent of what he is doing to you in game you can be banned. Imagine spending your hard earned money on this game and then getting banned because you tell some ganker to eat your ass.

Your advice is great for people who want to try and stick it out in this miserable game but the only real way to win eve is not to play. My hope is that new players who are interested in this 20 year old ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ fest will see this and go play something else.

Astrox Imperium is a great alternative, its a literal eve clone but without the ganking.

I see already, that this thread is just you shouting out your frustration and that you're not interested in a constructive conversation at all.
